role_sought: Member of the Government Council (Regierungsrat) of St. Gallen
detail: Elected to the St. Gallen cantonal government, taking over the Security and Justice Department. Repeatedly re-elected with top results through 2012.

election: Swiss Federal Council by-election (succession of Hans-Rudolf Merz)
detail: Narrowly failed in the fourth ballot; her FDP party colleague Johann Schneider-Ammann was elected to the seat.

election: Swiss federal election (Council of States, St. Gallen)
role_sought: Member of the Council of States
detail: Elected to the Council of States in the first round with about 65% of the vote; left the cantonal government in May 2012.

election: Swiss federal election (Council of States, St. Gallen)
role_sought: Re-election to the Council of States
detail: Re-elected to the Council of States with a strong result.

election: Swiss Federal Council election (succession of Johann Schneider-Ammann)
detail: Elected by the United Federal Assembly on the first ballot with 154 votes; fellow FDP candidate Hans Wicki received 56 votes. Elected alongside Viola Amherd (CVP).

election: Election of the President of the Confederation for 2025
detail: Elected by the United Federal Assembly as President of the Confederation for 2025 with 168 votes; had served as Vice President in 2024.
